curated.tagline: Seven public Agent Zero plugins: Argus review, OmaSeal, Jev compaction, device sync, durable runs, GlitchTip, Notion
curated.description: A suite of public plugins for the Agent Zero agent runtime, each in its own repository: pull-request review tools backed by Argus, OmaSeal secret access, Jev context compaction, device sync, durable run state, GlitchTip error reporting, and a Notion ingestion server. They appear here as components of one entry rather than seven.
highlights: Seven plugins, one per capability, each in its own public repository
Argus plugin exposes pull-request review as agent tools
Notion plugin runs as a local stdio MCP server
curated.architecture: Agent Zero runtime → plugin adapters → external service (Argus, Notion, GlitchTip, OmaSeal)
